summary: Publishes POP data from inside a component to an output connector on the parent component. It can output its wired input or reference another POP through Select POP.

key_params.name: selectpop
key_params.note: POP reference to output when no input is connected

key_params.name: label
key_params.note: Hover label shown on the parent component output connector

key_params.name: connectorder
key_params.note: Sort key for ordering parent component output connectors

key_concepts: One Out POP creates one parent output connector
Wired input takes precedence over Select POP reference output
Label text appears on the parent component output hover
common_gotchas: Each Out POP creates one parent output connector, so generated reusable components need deliberate output naming and ordering.
A wired input takes precedence over Select POP; use Select POP for reference-style output only when the input is intentionally empty.
Changing connectorder can break user expectations in component interfaces even if the internal network still cooks.
